title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Business Transactions with Clients - Conditions
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: If a paralegal enters into a permitted business transaction with a client, the transaction must be fair and reasonable to the client. How must the terms of the transaction be communicated?
options: Verbally, in the presence of an independent witness.
In writing, in a manner that can be reasonably understood by the client.
Implicitly, as long as the client continues to pay their legal bills.
questions.explain: Rule 3.06 outlines the strict rules for transactions with clients. One of the core requirements is that the terms must be fully disclosed in writing, in a manner reasonably understood by the client, alongside a recommendation for independent legal advice and written consent.
